about: Interview moments for scripts/capture/interview-bench.ts. 'files' = the instructor's question was about a requirement the course files state (how something is graded, what students submit), so a good interviewer searches and cites a passage. 'instructor' = only the instructor can answer (what students actually do), so searching is optional. Session = the first 8 characters of the capture session id. Turn = the interviewer turn to regenerate; the turn before it must be the instructor's. Chosen 2026-10-27 from the original transcripts; 'files' is a judgment from the transcript (the instructor's reply pointed at a rubric, brief or assignment), not checked against every file.
